name: "Piña Colada" Fruit Salad with Pineapple, Cashews & Coconut
instructions: Wash, dry, and cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice the flesh. Place in a medium bowl.
Add cashews and coconut to the bowl. Stir to combine the fruit salad.
To serve, divide fruit salad between bowls and enjoy!
author: Mealime
